split_rationale: Dev uses selected passages on pages 2–130; test uses disjoint passages on pages 140–189. All from one work: not independent documents; thematic/character overlap remains.
selection_rule: Then alphabetical strategy ID for deterministic final tie
filter_semantics: AND: page verse_start <= requested upper bound AND page verse_end >= requested lower bound. Page-range intersection, not gold-page lookup. A/B ignore filters; C applies supplied filter. No filter means unfiltered C.
metadata_definition: verse_start/end: 1-based sequential extracted verse-line ordinals, excluding blank lines, title and standalone printed number markers. Not claimed to be authoritative printed verse numbers. Chunks inherit page ranges; boundary pages may include out-of-range lines.
metrics: Hit requires one chunk containing complete documented evidence and a valid source/page. Normalize whitespace for matching, keep original traces. Accept documented equivalent/alternative gold only after source review; do not change strategy after test.
limitations: Small, single-work benchmark with thematic overlap
Range filters are synthetic user-supplied study scopes, explicitly stated in questions
Page-level range filter is coarse at boundary pages
AI authored gold verified by student; dev/test scores recorded; student accepted AI audit proposals, not independent blind scoring

execution_status.audit: student confirmed AI-assisted labels and metadata checks
